title: The Last Semester
author: J. M. Lockridge
blurb: Marguerite Nakamura, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
